products.title: Antioxidant Body Lotion - Apiceuticals

variants.description:
PROPOWAX™ SERIES
ANTIOXIDANT • ANTIPOLLUTION

100% Clean, Sustainable, Cruelty-free Beauty
10.1 fl. oz. / 300 ml

The PROPOWAX™ Antioxidant Body Lotion envelops the skin in silky hydration while fortifying it with advanced antioxidant protection. Powered by the patented Living Honeycomb, clinically proven to deliver the highest antioxidant activity worldwide, it locks in moisture, restores the skin barrier, and protects against pollution and oxidative stress. With its lightweight, non-greasy texture, it leaves skin velvety soft, supple, and wrapped in Apiceuticals’ signature ultra-luxury fragrance.

How to Use: Warm a coin-sized amount of lotion between your palms. Massage onto the body in gentle, circular motions, preferably after showering with PROPOWAX™ Antioxidant Shower Gel, while skin is still slightly damp.

For ultimate nourishment, complete the ritual with PROPOWAX™ Antioxidant Dry Oil.

Ingredients and Safety: Aqua (Water), Glycerin, Ethylhexyl Palmitate, Cetearyl Isonanoate, Prunus Amygdalus Dulcis (Sweet Almond) Oil, Olus Oil, Polyglyceryl-2 Dipolyhydroxystearate, Parfum (Fragrance), Passiflora Edulis Seed Oil, Lauryl Glucoside, Melissa Officinalis Flower Extract, Olea Europaea (Olive) Fruit Oil, Butyrospermum Parkii (Shea) Butter, Aloe Barbadensis Leaf Extract, Helianthus Annuus (Sunflower) Seed Oil, Sesamum Indicum (Sesame) Seed Oil, Vitis Vinifera (Grape) Seed Oil, Propolis Cera, Propolis Extract, Beeswax (Cera alba), Glyceryl Oleate, Dicaprylyl Carbonate, Carbomer, Sodium Stearoyl Glutamate, BHT, Sodium Benzoate, Potassium Sorbate, Honey/mel, Disodium EDTA, Benzyl Alcohol, Phenoxyethanol, Ethylhexylglycerin, Sodium Hydroxide, Hexyl Cinnamal, Limonene, Geraniol, Eugenol.

details_sections.heading: Golden Ingredients
details_sections.body:
Patented PROPOWAX™ LIVING HONEYCOMB
Powerful Antioxidant Activity

A revolutionary technology where a real honeycomb capsule is encapsulated within every bottle. Continuously releases antioxidants during use, repairing oxidative damage and protecting against pollution, UV, and stress.

ORGANIC HONEY
Seals in moisture

Rich in amino acids, vitamins, and minerals, it deeply hydrates and seals moisture, cocooning skin in softness and radiance.

ORGANIC BEE PROPOLIS
Seals in Moisture

A natural shield with antiviral, antibacterial, and anti-inflammatory powers. It reinforces the skin barrier, calms irritation, and balances the microbiome.

VIRGIN MARACUJA OIL
Nutritious Boost

Rich in omega-3 & 6 and vitamins A, C, E. This lightweight oil nourishes and balances hydration, leaving the skin with a natural glow.

ALMOND OIL
Prevents stretch marks

Packed with nutrients and fatty acids that soften and protect the skin, helping to improve elasticity and reduce the appearance of stretch marks.

VIRGIN OLIVE OIL
Deep Moisture

Nutrient-dense with vitamins A, D, K, and E. Intensely moisturizes, restores suppleness, and protects even the most sensitive skin.

ALOE VERA
Herbal Remedy

Rich in vitamins B, C, and E and minerals. Stimulates collagen and hyaluronic acid production, restores elasticity, and soothes irritation.

VIEW INCI LIST

details_sections.heading: FAQ
details_sections.body:
Is it free of SLS/SLES, Parabens, Silicones?

YES. Apiceuticals Clean Beauty excludes over 2,000 harmful ingredients. Strictly dermatologically tested with 0% irritation cases.

Is the honeycomb inside real?

Yes – the patented PROPOWAX™ Living Honeycomb is real. It continuously infuses antioxidants into the lotion and onto your skin.

Why are antioxidants important for body care?

Daily exposure to pollution, UV, and stressors generates free radicals that damage skin and accelerate aging. Antioxidants neutralize these effects, preserving smoothness, elasticity, and radiance.

Is it suitable for sensitive skin?

Yes – dermatologically tested on sensitive skin with 0% irritation. Gentle enough for daily use.

How does it smell?

WOODS OF ARCADIA
Apiceuticals' Signature Scent

– an ultra-luxury, fine fragrance created for haute perfumery.

Experience a true utopia of bliss with a spicy base from vanilla and sandalwood, rising through a sensual heart of cedarwood and blackberry, and finishing with heavenly top notes of citrus and pink pepper.

This is “Woods of Arcadia” – soft, golden, and quietly powerful – an olfactory signature of elegance, nature, and timeless luxury.

Fragrance Key Pyramid Notes:
Top: Citrus Notes, Pink Pepper, Cardamom
Middle: Apricot, Blackberry, Cedarwood
Base: Vanilla, Sandalwood, Patchouli, Agarwood
